snippet.title: Something Meangingful - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Something Meaningful is an open-world RPG where you decide how to live after your death. Work, study, train, explore the city, customize your appearance, meet cartoonish characters and unlock interesting locations as you try to do something meaningful with this new opportunity. Something Meaningful will be available on PC.
